title: Sieve admin HTTP API has no authentication
description: smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs:60-100: the Sieve admin HTTP API has zero built-in authentication. Config validation warns on non-loopback bind but does not prevent it. If an operator binds to 0.0.0.0:4190 (intentionally or by mistake), any network attacker can read, write, or delete Sieve scripts for all users — injecting a reject rule drops all mail for a user. Fix: require a bearer token (like the transit admin endpoint) or at minimum add a config flag that requires explicit opt-in to network exposure.
